mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_inbox_event ( event_id, consumer_name, outbox_event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, status, retry_count, locked_by, locked_until, replay_count ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{consumerName}, #{outboxEventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{lockedBy}, #{lockedUntil}, #{replayCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, consumer_name, outbox_event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, status, retry_count, locked_by, locked_until, last_error, replay_count, last_replay_by, last_replay_time, create_time, update_time, processed_time FROM tb_inbox_event WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_inbox_event SET status = 'PROCESSING', locked_by = #{lockedBy}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, last_error = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND status IN ('PROCESSING', 'RETRYING') AND ( locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until <= #{now} )

UPDATE tb_inbox_event SET status = 'SUCCESS', locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, processed_time = #{processedTime}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_by = #{lockedBy}

UPDATE tb_inbox_event SET status = 'RETRYING', retry_count = #{retryCount}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_by = #{lockedBy}

UPDATE tb_inbox_event SET status = 'DEAD', locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, processed_time = #{processedTime}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_by = #{lockedBy}

UPDATE tb_inbox_event SET status = 'RETRYING', retry_count = 0, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = #{now}, last_error = NULL, replay_count = replay_count + 1, last_replay_by = #{adminId}, last_replay_time = #{now}, processed_time = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE consumer_name = #{consumerName} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'DEAD'
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_inbox_event GROUP BY status
